about: Maximum hanger spacing used by revit_mep_hanger_plan and revit_mep_hanger_place. This table is shipped empty on purpose: the bridge does not know any standard and gives no engineering values. Add one rule per kind, material and size range, copy the numbers from the standard or supplier table your project follows, and name that table in 'source'. A rule without a 'source' text is never used. A rule with example true is never used either.
disclaimer: Layout aid only, not an engineering calculation. The spacing comes from the table you filled in; the tool does not check any code, load, support or structural capacity.

fields.material: free text, compared without case with the material argument of the call; leave empty to match any material
fields.size_min_mm: smallest nominal diameter (pipe, round duct) or width (rectangular duct, cable tray) the rule covers, millimetres
fields.size_max_mm: largest size the rule covers, millimetres
fields.max_spacing_mm: largest distance between two hangers on a straight run, millimetres
fields.min_fitting_distance_mm: optional: nearest a hanger may be to a fitting, millimetres (the call can override it)
fields.source: required: the standard, supplier table or project document the numbers come from, with clause or page
fields.example: true marks a row that only shows the layout; it is never used

rules.note: EXAMPLE ONLY. Copy this row, fill in your own numbers and a real source, and set example to false (or delete the flag).
